description: This file defines a custom Lint Detector (`TestMethodNameDetector`) for Android projects, which checks Java/Kotlin test methods for naming conventions. It verifies that test methods do not unnecessarily start with 'test' and adhere to specific naming patterns such as `given_when_then`. The detector targets methods annotated with `@Test` and provides quick fixes for renaming issues.

classes.name: TestMethodNameDetector
classes.description: A Lint Detector class that identifies test method naming issues and provides reporting and quick fixes.

methods.name: applicableAnnotations
methods.description: Returns the list of annotations (`@Test`) that this detector applies to.

methods.name: visitAnnotationUsage
methods.description: Called when a relevant annotation is used; triggers detection of prefix and format issues on the method.

methods.name: isAndroidTest
methods.description: Checks if the current file is an Android test (located in the 'androidTest' directory).

methods.name: detectPrefix
methods.description: Detects if a test method name starts with 'test' and recommends filename removal.

methods.name: detectFormat
methods.description: Checks if test method naming follows the `given_when_then` or `when_then` format in Android tests.
